rubric_version.description: Semver of the rubric. See docs/versioning.md.

scale.description: Half-range for every axis: positions run -scale..+scale. Shared by all axes so they stay comparable. A display multiplier on the normalized weighted mean, it does not change any relative position.

evidence_exclude.description: Globs naming files a judged answer may not cite as evidence, matched case-sensitively against the answer's path relative to the target root. Same glob syntax as path signals: '**' spans directories, '*' and '?' stay within one path segment. A judged answer whose path matches any glob stays unresolved.

items.description: Axis id, matching a directory under axes/.
